scope: C0 Swift Stormflight only; optional actual Q attack feedback, not a Q/Swift rotation or current-game certification
supplements: manifest.json; original source.json.gz and original talent binding remain unchanged

additionalReadOnlySource.identityLimit: Downloaded fixed raw URL, computed byte/blob hashes; no claim of independent tree verification. Original source is not copied into this supplement.

formula.beneficiary: Only the current active character, including Iansan herself (Optimizer index.tsx121; gcsim burst.go89-105).
formula.recursionExclusion: Q is Extra:true and updateATKBuff uses SelectStat(true,BaseATK,ATKP,ATK), which skips every Extra StatMod. Optimizer reads premod.atk before the Q team total.atk addition. Do not reconstruct this input from a final imported ATK.
formula.sampleTiming: gcsim refreshes immediately on Q and queues each next refresh after18 character-task frames. Inputs must describe the actual most recent refresh used by this hit, not automatically its current NS or current ATK.
formula.a1Interaction: Prior A1 is ordinary 20% base ATK and may enter the Q update input when actually present then. A1 at Q update and A1 at hit snapshot can differ. This Swift awards/refreshes its new A1 after damage, so it never boosts itself or retroactively changes an earlier Q update.
formula.effectiveQLevel: Explicit independent effective burst level1-15; no inference from Swift NA level and no additional constellation boost.
formula.zero: Explicit zero ATK or zero NS returns zero; unknown is not zero. A known off-field owner receives zero from her own Q.
formula.cap: The cap is a fixed flat-ATK limit, not a percent of base ATK.
formula.onFieldProof: For a complete legal one-cast schedule with no hitlag/interruption/replacement, Swift snapshot and impact25f precede its earliest legal swap31f. Its allowed Q follow-up24f keeps Iansan active. Thus self-on-field is derived, without writing player observations; explicit off-field contradicts this bounded full action. Independent hits and incomplete schedules do not inherit this proof.

limitations: C1-C6 are still rejected; C1 resource, C2 A1 grant/party buff, C4 NS restore and C6 damage/duration are not silently omitted.
No automatic Q lifetime, expiry, movement, NS generation/consumption or energy/cooldown simulation.
Actual Q refresh attack and NS observations are mandatory for an on-field active-Q branch, including historical snapshots. Old inputs do not acquire this evidence automatically.
Historical final snapshots require explicit actual-Q-included confirmation and are never increased again. Converted snapshots retain exact source-state/talent identity.
Original conflicting gcsim Swift E-level index remains archived; resolved NA binding remains in force.
